info.title: Tollkit Data
info.description: SEC filings and financials, IP lookup, weather, airport delays, address geocoding, exchange rates, and x402 market data. Other Tollkit tools are described at: https://extract.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://attest.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://web.tollkit.dev/openapi.json, https://chain.tollkit.dev/openapi.json.
info.x-guidance: Call any operation with POST and the JSON body its schema shows. Without payment you get HTTP 402 with the exact price in USDC on Base or Solana; pay with any x402 client and repeat the request. Failed calls (any 4xx or 5xx) are never charged. Each operation's description says what it returns and which inputs are refused for free.

post.description: SEC company lookup: give a US stock ticker or CIK, get the company's legal name, exchange, industry, state, fiscal year end and its latest SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4...) with direct links, optionally filtered by form. Straight from SEC EDGAR. $0.002 per call; an unknown ticker is not charged.

post.description: Company financials from SEC filings: give a US stock ticker or CIK, get revenue, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow and shares outstanding for the last 4 fiscal years plus the latest quarter, exactly as filed in XBRL, each with its filing and accession number. From SEC EDGAR. $0.004 per call; a company with no financial data is not charged.

post.description: Weather anywhere in the world: give a latitude and longitude (or a US street address), get the forecast for the next 7 days in day and night periods (temperature, rain, wind, summary). In the US it comes from the National Weather Service, with any active weather alerts for that spot; elsewhere from MET Norway. $0.002 per call; a failed lookup is not charged.

schema.description: Give lat and lon (anywhere in the world), or a US street address.

address.description: US street address instead of lat/lon, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500".

temperature_unit.description: F in the US (National Weather Service), C elsewhere (MET Norway)

precipitation_mm.description: Expected rain or snow in mm, outside the US

alerts_note.description: Outside the US: weather alerts are only available for US locations.

times.description: Outside the US: times are UTC; day and night follow approximate local time.

geocoded.description: Present when you sent an address: what the Census geocoder matched it to.

post.description: Currency conversion at European Central Bank reference rates: give two currency codes (30 supported, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY) and an amount, get the rate and converted amount for the latest business day or any day in the last 90. NOTE: these ECB reference rates are published free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; they are for information only, not for transactions. $0.002 per call; an unsupported currency is not charged.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD within the last 90 days; weekends use the previous business day.

notice.description: Required by the ECB: these rates are free at ecb.europa.eu and are for information only.

post.summary: Best x402 tools for a task
post.description: Find the best paid x402 tool for a task: describe what you need ("web search", "token price on solana"), get matching endpoints ranked by paying wallets and whether buyers come back, not raw call counts, one per seller, with price and a caution where a seller's numbers look unusual. Tollkit runs this ranking and sells tools too; its own are ranked the same way and marked. $0.01 per call; a task with no match is not charged.

sold_by_tollkit.description: True for Tollkit's own tools. Tollkit runs this ranking; its tools get no boost.

disclosure.description: Tollkit runs this ranking and also sells tools.
